direct_bootstrap.stdout:
usage: p2_lab.py [-h] --truth TRUTH --out OUT
                 [--freeze-receipt FREEZE_RECEIPT] [--n N]
                 [--competition-cost-lambda COMPETITION_COST_LAMBDA]
                 [--depth-subset DEPTH_SUBSET] [--gate GATE] [--block BLOCK]
                 [--ts TS] [--note NOTE] --control CONTROL
                 [--official-samples OFFICIAL_SAMPLES]
                 [--residual-cap RESIDUAL_CAP]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --truth TRUTH
  --out OUT
  --freeze-receipt FREEZE_RECEIPT
                        immutable P07 coefficient-to-four-arm freeze receipt
  --n N                 0 = every network in the truth file
  --competition-cost-lambda COMPETITION_COST_LAMBDA
                        Phase-2 score-cost lambda; must be zero and is
                        distinct from the fitted K4 coefficient
  --depth-subset DEPTH_SUBSET
                        networks used for the MSE-by-depth mechanism curve
  --gate GATE           pre-registered promotion gate; REQUIRED to print a
                        verdict
  --block BLOCK         the seed block this truth belongs to. Inferred from
                        the filename when it carries a block id; REQUIRED
                        otherwise, because guessing is how a single-use block
                        gets read twice.
  --ts TS               historical event timestamp only; omit for an automatic
                        runtime receipt
  --note NOTE           recorded on the read line
  --control CONTROL     the registered control; must be 'exact'
  --official-samples OFFICIAL_SAMPLES
                        official truth samples used for the precision forecast
  --residual-cap RESIDUAL_CAP
                        override the 0.4 s cliff for an ACCURACY-ONLY run. <=0
                        disables it entirely. The relaxation is printed and
                        recorded; such a run is never residual evidence.
